text:
cheng: pager — sustained tail latency spike on /v1/generate (prod-us) after 09:12 deploy, multiple 504s seen by customers
incident-bot: INC-7602 created · severity P1 · notify: #eng-oncall #eng-runtime · bridge: https://zoom.fake/INC-7602
sam: seeing 95th p95 jump from 120ms -> 2.3s, error budget burning, rolling back?
maria: rollback in progress for canary subset, flipping routing policy to legacy as hotfix, monitoring logs now
lex: interesting, KV cache hit rate dropped to 12% at same time — looks like cache warmup/regeneration churned after deploy
cheng: confirmed regen — KV shards bounced due to schema tweak in runtime that invalidated cache keys
rachel: customer report from AcmeHealth: timeouts impacting ingestion pipeline, opened support ticket #SUP-1123, escalating with account team
sam: notify support + accounts, set expectation: we measure impact window and follow up with RCA + remediation plan
maria: hotfix patch applied at 09:19 (routing->legacy), p95 back down to 160ms at 09:24, 504s drop to zero; leaving canary paused
lex: short-term mitigation accepted. Next: we should add an automated cache prewarm job for rollouts + gate canary until warmup confirms >60% hit rate
cheng: agree. Also need an on-call playbook tweak so next rotation knows to check cache-hit dashboards post-deploy (step added to deploy checklist)
incident-bot: timeline entry: deploy 09:11, spike 09:12, rollback 09:19, mitigated 09:24
ch
eng: ping @oncall-next — handing off incident summary for final wrap and post-incident scheduling
oncall-next: taking it — brief summary: cache invalidation bug in runtime triggered KV shard rekeys during canary, caused warmup cold starts and latency spike, customer visible for ~12m; mitigation: routing fallback + paused canary
sam: propose post-incident review (PIR) Wed 2026-03-25 10:00 PT (30m), invite SRE, runtime, product, support; DRI: lex
maria: adding agenda: timeline, RCA, action items, owner + ETA, customer comms draft
lex: action items I already see: (1) add cache prewarm job + rollout gating (owner: lex, ETA: 2w) (2) runtime change to avoid shard rekey on minor schema changes (owner: cheng, ETA: 3w) (3) playbook update: add post-deploy cache check + slack alert (owner: maria, ETA: 1w) (4) support comms template + SLA impact note (owner: rachel, ETA: 3d)
rachel: I'll draft customer message and coordinate with accounts, will attach to PIR notes
sam: assigning trackers: create tickets in tracker under ENG-OPS with the action items and link to PIR doc
cheng: quick note for the follow-up: add a test that simulates canary cache regeneration under load so we don't regress this silently
lex: +1, include perf tests in CI that validate KV hit-rate thresholds for canary traffic shape
incident-bot: post-incident checklist prompt: "Schedule PIR?" — responded: yes by sam
ch
eng: thanks everyone — leaving a brief handoff: all mitigations stable, monitoring for residual anomalies for 24h, DRI lex for PIR
sam: I'll create the calendar invite and tracker tickets, will ping channel when values are linked
maria: updating deploy checklist now (will PR and tag eng-runtime) :hammer_and_wrench:
lex: will owner the PIR and start drafting RCA outline
rachel: support message draft ETA EOD today
cheng: adding unit + integration tests for schema change path this afternoon
lex: closing note — we should also review routing policy change impact on bursty workloads in next architecture sync
incident-bot: incident INC-7602 transitioned to post-incident review state
